limitations: Roster eligibility and game-day-active fields are unknown for the simulated players; the run does not establish eligibility.
The weeks 1-8 snap extract is retrospective and has no acquisition timestamp. It is not verified as an official-cutoff capture.
Missing observed rows do not establish inactivity. Observed percentages are conditional on recorded rows.
Observed offensive snaps and modeled skill-lineup appearances are not identical definitions; the lineup field excludes QB and offensive-line appearances.
Twenty seeds per arm across three games are exploratory; this does not justify a production default change.
